title: Numerical Stability: log-sum-exp, overflow & conditioning
interviewAnswer: Mathematically equivalent formulas can behave very differently in floating point. Stable implementations avoid overflow/underflow, poor conditioning and subtractive cancellation.
keyPoints: Avoid explicit matrix inversion when solves/decompositions are available.
Scale values and inspect NaN/Inf early.
why: Numerical Stability: log-sum-exp, overflow & conditioning is a recurring foundation across data science and machine learning because it affects both theoretical correctness and practical system behavior.
